blocks.text: As I was getting ready to write this letter many important events have transpired around the world concerning weather. Many floods have taken place instantly, without warning. We have in the U.S. – Ark, Ok, Tn, as well as many tornadoes, and the season is just getting started! We have Brazil, France and also many other countries being hit by unusual weather. If that isn’t bad enough we have a great catastrophe unfolding in the Gulf for about the last 60 days. In the end it may devastate the oil company that drilled the well. Should this happen, this event with the British Petroleum Co. could devastate many businesses and be more serious than the banking crisis with Lehman Brothers. The ripple effect would be felt around the world. Concerning this event, just to bring this into perspective, should the collapse of the derivative market which is now standing at $l.2 quadrillion, all representing debt! The world’s entire production is somewhere between 50 and 60 trillion dollars annually. So one can see how out of balance this debt market is. – A crucial important meeting is taking place about the exact hour of the June eclipse and the grand square and the transition of the next 7-year cycle. The meeting is all about the economic conditions in all nations, which are in a debt crisis. Now one can see how the anti-Christ will be able to come during the crisis that is about to unfold on all of the financial markets. This will bring us to the head of gold just like Nebuchadnezzar had (Dan. 2:31,32 – Dan. 3:1,6), a standard that all nations will have to obey under the mark of the beast (Rev. 13:16,17.) – God’s judgement is beginning to come to its fullness. The immoralities and sins are so great that there is no other course for God to take. This is leading me to a quote from Brother Frisby that I know will explain some of this. And now a quote from Neal Frisby. “Jesus made a multitude of promises both to the Gentiles and Jews in the Old and New Testament. One by one, a little here, and a little there through history they were fulfilled! And now in our generation they are like a flood of events swiftly taking place! In fact, practically all of the prophecies for the church-elect have taken place except for the quick gathering and the going away! – The next thing awaiting now is The Covenant with the Jews with a false messiah. – Then all the Tribulation Scriptures begin to unfold! – We are definitely entering a ‘new era’ of revolutionary changes. Things never seen before in our generation, but a fulfillment of prophecy! New leadership around the world is taking place. And through crises and upheavals new laws concerning economics and society will definitely occur!” “Israel has come a long way since the cities were delivered out of the Arabs hands by the first airplane in 1917.” (Isa. 31:5) And through events planned by God bit by bit and by cycles, the Jews returned and became a nation again after World War II. – He then told the season of His return as the ‘Fig Tree’ budded in our generation, and it includes the Battle of Armageddon! – Also there are only a few years left in our generation any way you look at it! – My opinion is these two Scriptures will take place soon. Rev. 11:1-2 – II Thess. 2:4 – “The financial men in their secret society is working on this now! – Israel (God’s time clock to the Gentile) will be in agreement because it looks so good to them, but it will be utter deception!” “The United States also will fall under deception; as one can see great delusion is covering the land! The Babylon religion is rising up and controlling all facets of life! – False phenomena and signs are increasing concerning this and all type sorcery, including movie magic and unbelievable fantasy replacing reality. – This is a prophetic sign of Jesus return! – And even in some of the youths music they are singing of the beast and the number 666, luring them into it! Also telling them that they want to go to hell, in defiance of God’s Word! – The Pied Piper’s leading the youths to the gates of hell! The Scripts over 35 years ago predicted these events to occur. How accurate the Holy Spirit is. Pray for our youth, they are confronted with a thousand different temptations and snares daily!” – “In another dimension, witchcraft and sorcery are doing some of the same things only animals and children are used at times for sacrifices! We could go on and on, but this is revealing the fulfillment of prophecy that the Scripts foretold many years ago, that would occur in our day!” “The cup of iniquity will be running over. Man is reaching his last phases! God through quakes is trying to shake some sense into the population before its too late! – The writing above may seem bold, but nevertheless, true facts cannot be overlooked! – Some is unprintable, but we will say this, when 8 and 10-year-old girls are selling their bodies on the streets, it is time for the church to pray without ceasing for our young people! – We are not defeated, some will be saved! – The Lord said, “I shall restore!” – A quick visitation is coming among us! – Praise Him!”

“All of the above pleasure and sins that we wrote of will be entering into Great Babylon, Rev. chap. 17 and Rev. 18:13. – But in one hour it will all be wiped out (vs. 10). Fire, gases and radiation winds will sweep them away, leaving those left in astonishment!” – “I don’t want to sound like a minister of doom but if I did not tell the truth about all these things, their blood would be on my hands when I face the living God! – For it says, that we will be held accountable if we do not warn!” End quote. I have two Special Writings that will bring us closer to the hour that we’re living in called “Providential Time – Approaching Prophecy – (Ezekiel 38)” and “Daniel’s Visions.” Also I am releasing a DVD, “God’s Love and Judgement.” (See offer below.) What a time to be part of this great witness! When you help this ministry publish this important message your prayers and support will be counted in heaven! Your Brother in Christ,
